regime_context: Detector shows narrow, mean-reverting China A-share tape: only 8 of 22 themes eligible, rotation breadth is 'narrowing' and the absolute-trend gate did NOT hold on this market's history (gate_helps=false), so the validated drawdown edge is absent here. Gold Miners leads on rank/durability but is unscorable (no ETF proxy); the scorable leaders are AI Compute & Optics and Industrial Metals. Backtest verdicts mark momentum rank as an attention lens only and rotation timing as display-only, so any lean must be low-conviction and conditional.
emerging_watch: Watching Coal (515220.SS): mean-revert hurst_tag with breadth 1.0 and crowding_z 0.9 suggests a fully-participated, fully-crowded theme that may be mature; the retirement condition is a downside close in Coal below its 50-day average while Industrial Metals (512400.SS) holds above its 20-day average.

theses.subject: Industrial Metals
theses.thesis: Industrial Metals is the highest-ranked scorable theme with trend-consistent structure: hurst_tag 'trend', durability_bar 0.77, breadth 0.769 (broad participation vs AI Compute's 0.118), and non-crowded (crowding_z -0.20). Unlike the leader Gold Miners it has a scorable proxy (512400.SS), making the lean testable. The lean rests on the trend-gate and durability legs suggesting a coherent, healthy trend rather than a one-stock spike, while acknowledging the gate itself has no validated drawdown edge on this mean-reverting market.
theses.dissent: The backtest verdict says this market's trend gate did not reduce drawdown and the tape whipsaws trend followers; a trend-consistent ranking may simply mark a local top rather than durable leadership.

falsifier.text: 512400.SS fails to close above its 20-day average at any point in the next 20 trading days.

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: AI Compute & Optics is the challenger to the leader with rank 2 and score 1.555, scorable via 515000.SS. It is the only high-ranked theme with the macro-narrative tailwind (ai_tech is the dominant macro theme with 54 of 89 recent mentions). However, breadth is very thin (0.118) and durability_bar is only 0.46 with 'mixed' trend — the rank is concentrated leadership, not broad cohesion. The lean is conditional on the narrative remaining intact and breadth improving; otherwise it is a crowded-narrow spike risk.
theses.dissent: Thin breadth of 0.118 means one or two names carry the whole theme; on a mean-reverting tape, concentrated leadership is fragile and a single profit-taking bout can unwind the theme without warning.

falsifier.text: 515000.SS lags the CSI 300 by 3% or more before the 15-day check.

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Innovative Pharma & CXO ranks 3 and is scorable via 159992.SZ, but is flagged crowded (crowding_z 1.45, crowded=true) with modest durability_bar 0.57 and 'mixed' trend. Per guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution, never a fade or short — so the honest expression of discomfort with a crowded, mixed-trend theme is to avoid adding exposure rather than underweight. There is no evidence of a confirmed handoff away from it, so no underweight call is justified.
evidence: guardrails: crowding is a size-down caution, never a fade
theses.dissent: Reflexivity means the crowded theme can keep running as long as inflows persist; avoiding it may mean missing continued upside if the narrative stays intact.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ breaks above its 52-week high on expanding volume before the check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
